lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five visible vertical columns of high-luminance white spots located posterior to the gill slits, with increasing spatial separation between centroids as they transition toward the mid-body.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity white blobs are positioned at the intersection of faint, diffuse vertical bands and the primary lateral axis, creating a distinct grid-like matrix across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with a specular highlight on the superior edge and a defined shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of smaller, irregularly shaped high-luminance spots compared to the more structured grid on the lateral body.
